description: Independent checks for agents, paid per call in USDC on Base over x402 with a free Base Sepolia trial: skillcheck reviews a skill or MCP server's files before install for piped installers, credential reads, exfiltration, persistence, hidden Unicode, and instructions aimed at the agent; accept checks another agent's deliverable against its task before payment; check reviews a draft before the human sees it. Every result has a signed receipt.

CROSSCHECK_WALLET_KEY.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet that pays per check (a few dollars of USDC on Base, or free test USDC on Base Sepolia). Never your main wallet. Only needed for paid checks; skillcheck lookups are free.

CROSSCHECK_NETWORKS.description: Networks the client may pay on, in order of preference. Set eip155:84532 to use Base Sepolia test USDC only.

CROSSCHECK_MAX_USD.description: Refuse to pay more than this per check.

name: crosscheck
